prompt: Some people believe that celebrity personal events ia a waste of money. Others feel that these celebrations play an important role in the lives of individual and in society as a whole. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Some people believe that celebrating personal events is a waste of money, while others think that these celebrations are important for individuals and society. This essay will discuss both views. In my opinion, personal celebrations are important, but people should spend money wisely.

On the one hand, some people think that personal events are a waste of money. Celebrations such as weddings, birthdays and graduation parties can cost a lot of money. People may spend money on food, clothes, decorations and entertainment. This money could be used for more important things, such as education, buying a house or saving for the future. For example, some people have a large wedding party even though they do not have enough savings.

On the other hand, other people believe that celebrations are important in our lives and society. Personal events can bring family and friends together. They also give people an opportunity to share happiness and create good memories. For example, a wedding celebration can bring two families together and make their relationship closer. In addition, celebrations can help people feel connected to their community.

In my opinion, personal celebrations are useful and important, but they do not need to be expensive. People should celebrate important moments with their family and friends according to their financial situation. Spending too much money only for a celebration can cause financial problems in the future.

In conclusion, some people see personal celebrations as unnecessary spending, while others consider them important for individuals and society. I believe that celebrations are valuable, but people should control their spending.
